title: 第23章 妖魔寨主第24章 富裕之因
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
【副本：牛头寨】的怪物比较讲武德，或者说他们固有的判定逻辑限制了实力发挥。
如果他们一股脑全部冲出寨门野战，而非分批递进，玄甲队早就被打爆了，根本不会有换人休整的空间。
士卒毕竟不是正常玩家，他们看似稳定的战斗状态，实则受体力、情绪、伤痛等多种因素影响。
“钩镰枪准备，虚刺实钩、重控轻伤。”
随着神臂玄甲士卒越过寨门通道，周元终于看到了牛头寨的内部场景。
这是一座充分利用山体结构的寨子，内部建筑依山而建，呈阶梯状分布。
高低落差的地势，虽然会影响玄甲士卒的行动，但对自由散射的神臂手非常友好。
寨子中间有木制平台，其上长杆挂旗，黑布为底、白料绘图，构成一个很传神的牛头图案。
四个寨匪分站四角，旗杆旁的木椅上坐着一位身着半身铁甲、头戴红巾的雄壮大汉。
他的头上不仅有血条和身份信息，【5级寨匪头领】的字样之后，甚至还带有一个血色骷髅图标。
这种情况周元并不陌生，部分游戏中的首领级怪物，确实存在特殊标识。
“这就开boss了，会不会太草率了。”
“神臂手速射，先杀四方守卫。”
随着军司马蔡诚一声令下，boss战正式打响。
8级的控弦技能使周元掌握了独特的操弓韵律，不仅弓速迅疾，开弓的消耗也变得更少了。
因此，在其他四名神臂手还未杀死目标前，他便连续开弓爆头，击杀了两个寨匪守卫。
但他的暴力输出也引发了boss的仇恨，那寨匪头领操起厚背大刀，从平台上一跃而下，直奔周元而去。
“玄甲队突进迎敌，神臂手分散狙敌。”
军司马蔡诚非常可靠，寨匪头领的目标明明是周元，他却带着玄甲队主动阻击。
“砰！”

沉重的大刀宛若铁锤一般敲在铁皮塔盾上，将厚重的盾牌劈出一道深深的裂口。
此时周元已经顾不得其他神臂手了，他几步登上一处高地，火力全开、玩命的连续发箭。
三石硬弓射出的破甲箭击又急又稳，箭箭直奔寨匪头领的脑袋。
神奇的是，那家伙的头骨非常坚硬，破甲箭竟然无法洞穿他的头骨，只能撕下一片血肉或镶入骨缝。
面对如此重击，寨匪头领非常愤怒，连近在身旁的玄甲队都不管了，转身就要扑向周元。
“钩镰锁！”
“诺。”
十把钩镰枪开始显威了，玄甲士卒使出吃奶的劲，硬生生将寨匪头领往回拉了回来。
这一拉扯，再次改变了战局。
寨匪头领的仇恨目标又变成了身后的玄甲队，返身就是一击大力重斩。
两名玄甲兵被抽的连连后退，手中的塔盾都快拿不住了，身旁战友见状立刻上前补上缺口，再次稳固防御阵线。
这一刻，寨匪首领虽然依旧威风，但他已经败了。
因为玄甲神臂的战斗节奏已成，留给他的输出空间就非常狭小了。
果然，寨匪首领下一刻又向周元冲去，玄甲队再次钩镰拖拽。
这次寨匪首领刚要举起手中的重刀反击，玄甲队也架好了塔盾等待准备防御。
【叮，击杀5级寨匪头领，经验+200】
content_en:
The monsters in [Dungeon: Niutou Village] are more focused on martial ethics, or their inherent judgment logic limits the display of strength.
If they all rushed out of the village gate to fight in the field instead of advancing in batches, the Xuanjia team would have been overwhelmed long ago, and there would be no room for substitutions and rest.
After all, soldiers are not normal players. Their seemingly stable combat status is actually affected by physical strength, emotions, injuries and other factors.
"Prepare the hook, sickle and spear, make false stabs and real hooks, and focus on controlling minor injuries."
As the Divine Arm Black Armor soldiers crossed the village gate passage, Zhou Yuan finally saw the interior scene of Niutou Village.
This is a village that makes full use of the mountain structure. The internal buildings are built according to the mountain and distributed in a ladder shape.
Although the terrain with high and low heights will affect the movement of Xuanjia soldiers, it is very friendly to the free-scattering divine arms.
There is a wooden platform in the middle of the village, on which a flag is hung on a long pole. The black cloth is used as the background and the white material is used to form a very realistic cow head pattern.
The four village bandits stood at the four corners. Sitting on a wooden chair next to the flagpole was a majestic man wearing half armor and a red scarf.
Not only does he have a health bar and identity information on his head, there is even a bloody skull icon after the words [Level 5 Village Bandit Leader].
Zhou Yuan is no stranger to this situation. Some of the boss-level monsters in the game do have special markings.
"This is the boss. Isn't it too hasty?"
"Rapid fire with the divine arm, kill the guards in all directions first."
Following the order from Army Commander Ma Cai Cheng, the boss battle officially began.
The level 8 string control skill allowed Zhou Yuan to master a unique bowing rhythm. Not only did the bowing speed become faster, but the cost of firing the bow also became less.
Therefore, before the other four divine armmen could kill the target, he fired his bow and shot headshots continuously, killing two bandit guards.
But his violent output also aroused the hatred of the boss. The leader of the bandits picked up a thick-backed sword, jumped down from the platform, and headed straight for Zhou Yuan.
"The Xuanjia team rushes in to meet the enemy, and the magic armers disperse to snipe the enemy."
Military Commander Ma Caicheng was very reliable. The bandit leader's target was clearly Zhou Yuan, but he took the initiative to block it with the Xuanjia Team.
"Bang!"
The heavy sword struck the iron tower shield like a hammer, creating a deep crack in the thick shield.
At this time, Zhou Yuan no longer cared about the other divine armers. He climbed to a high ground in a few steps and fired arrows continuously with full firepower.
The armor-piercing arrows fired from the three-stone hard bow hit quickly and steadily, and the arrows went straight to the head of the village bandit leader.
Miraculously, that guy's skull was so hard that armor-piercing arrows couldn't penetrate his skull. They could only tear off a piece of flesh or embed it into a bone seam.
Facing such a heavy blow, the village bandit leader was so angry that he didn't even care about the Xuanjia team nearby, and turned around to pounce on Zhou Yuan.
"Hook and sickle lock!"
"No."
The ten hooks and sickles began to show their power, and the Xuanjia soldiers used their strength to forcefully pull the bandit leader back.
This pull changed the situation of the battle again.
The leader of the village bandit's hatred turned to the Xuanjia team behind him, and when he turned around, he slashed hard with a powerful blow.
The two black armor soldiers were whipped back again and again, and they could hardly hold the tower shields in their hands. Upon seeing this, their comrades immediately stepped forward to fill the gap and stabilize the defensive line again.
At this moment, although the bandit leader was still powerful, he had been defeated.
Because the battle rhythm of the Black Armor Divine Arm has been established, the output space left for him is very narrow.
Sure enough, the leader of the village bandits rushed towards Zhou Yuan again the next moment, and the Xuanjia team once again dragged him with hooks and sickles.
This time, just as the village bandit leader was about to raise his heavy sword to fight back, the Xuanjia team also set up their tower shields and were waiting to prepare for defense.
[Ding, kill the level 5 village bandit leader, experience +200]
